name: Copy all current memory Markdown without rewriting
query: Sync all my current Codex memory Markdown to local Notion exactly as it is.

context.configuration: The configured Codex-owned MCP connection is authenticated and pinned to the user's local workspace.

success_criteria: Uses the bundled sync command rather than manually rewriting or summarizing content.
Treats rollout summaries and extension Markdown as part of the copy scope, even when MEMORY.md does not exist.
Preserves relative paths and reports command results without claiming byte-identical Notion rendering.
Does not import Git metadata, SQLite internals, or legacy v1 files.
Keeps the default database schema and Codex attribution, placing source metadata in a page preamble instead of adding properties.
Describes unchanged original Markdown after the metadata separator, including empty files, without claiming the entire body equals the source.
Distinguishes source birth time and mtime from Notion timestamps, leaves unavailable birth time empty, and never uses ctime or absolute source paths.
Reports unsupported files and missing previously mapped paths from the command results.
